exposure: Cause of previous fetal death (ReCoDe classification)
Treatment with low molecular weight heparin (LMWH)
Treatment with both LDA and LMWH
outcome: Adverse neonatal outcome (perinatal death, stillbirth recurrence, intrauterine growth restriction, early preterm birth, Apgar < 7 at 5 minutes, need for neonatal resuscitation)
Adverse maternal outcome (postpartum hemorrhage, emergency cesarean delivery, operative vaginal delivery)
cohort: The study participants were patients with a history of stillbirth (>=22 weeks) who subsequently became pregnant between 2014 and 2022 across four Italian University Hospitals.
finding: Treatment with LDA + LMWH reduced adverse neonatal outcomes by 75% in individuals with previous placental vascular disorders, but adverse maternal outcomes were significantly higher in those receiving LDA + LMWH without specific indications.
